title: Dreams in 2D? Flat like paper dolls?
content: Forgive me if this is the wrong sub. I was always a lucid dreamer since I was little. Frequently missing Saturday morning cartoons so that I could “finish my dreams”. It was only in recent years that I’ve learned it was lucid dreaming. But one particular recurring dream/theme is a realm where everything is in 2D. Everyone looks like paper cut outs. Where you become a line when you turn sideways. It was less specific to a particular location and more so that everything I knew was suddenly 2D. I can still recall what my tongue and throat feel like in 2D. It’s probably been a year since I last visited the flat realm. And it’s one where I would recall the dream when I woke, because of how my body felt, and I could often go back to sleep and return. Has anyone else ever experienced this flat place?
